jobs.title: VP, Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

Rakuten Kobo brings the best reading experience to millions of readers worldwide. We operate ebook and audiobook storefronts across dozens of markets, build our own eReaders and reading apps, and run a content and technology platform that few companies of our size can match.

Here at Rakuten Kobo Inc. we offer a casual working start-up environment and a group of friendly and talented individuals. Our employees rank us highly in terms of commitment to work/life balance. We realize that for our people to be innovative, creative and passionate they need to feel valued and supported. We believe in rewarding all our employees with competitive salaries, performance based annual bonuses, stock options and training opportunities.

If you’re looking for a company that inspires passion, personal, and professional growth – join Kobo and come help us on our mission of making reading lives better.

The Role

You will lead the architecture function for all of Kobo's products and services, reporting to the CTO and leading a team of four domain architects covering commerce and discovery, purchasing and reading services, eReader platforms, and data engineering.

This is a VP-level leadership role exercised through architecture, not through P&L. You hold decision authority over Kobo's technology architecture — but your leverage comes from setting direction, defining the decision frameworks others use, and making the org better at making good calls without you in the

room. You stay close to the code through design reviews and architecture forums.

The Landscape You'll Shape

Our third-generation ecommerce, ad-tech, marketing automation, and personalization platform, powering storefronts in over 40 geos
Reading experience on iOS and Android apps, on the desktop Webreader, and our eReader devices
A rich content catalog and data model powering search, discovery, and syndication with retail partners

What You'll Do

Lead, grow, and develop the architecture team — four domain architects with coverage across our major technology areas, with hiring authority as the function grows
Run the architecture guild and practice forums. The guild is how architectural change is communicated to the broader engineering org; the practice forums are where major architectural changes and questions get surfaced and stress-tested with our principal and staﬀ engineers and architects.
Grow both into the venue where Kobo's biggest technical decisions are made
Identify gaps in our software ecosystem and drive the roadmap that closes them, in partnership with the CTO
Define the decision rubrics and frameworks that let engineering teams make sound architectural calls autonomously — your influence should scale far beyond your calendar
Champion pragmatic, incremental architecture: reduce complexity, improve velocity and reliability, and keep tactical delivery and long-term evolution moving together

What Success Looks Like (first 12–24 Months)

The architecture guild and practice forums are thriving — well-attended, respected, and the de facto venue where big architectural decisions are communicated and debated
The flagship cross-functional initiatives are advancing or delivered, with architecture playing a visible, decisive role
There is a living, prioritized view of gaps in our software ecosystem, with a roadmap the CTO and R&D leadership team buy into

The Skillset

We are not screening for a specific technology checklist. What's essential:

10+ years building and architecting software, including senior leadership experience (Architect /Principal / Director level) in software development organizations
Deep understanding of how large-scale systems hang together — distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data platforms, and the modern design patterns and frameworks that hold them up
Curiosity and the ability to learn independently — you'll inherit a broad, varied estate, and nobody will hand you a manual
Collaboration and communication — you can facilitate design sessions, deliver training, evangelize technology choices, and earn the trust of engineers more senior in their domains than you areA track record of defining frameworks and decision rubrics that help other people make good calls, rather than hoarding the decisions yourself

Nice To Have (context For Our Environment, Not Requirements)

Experience in ecommerce or ad-tech platforms operating at significant scale, in both real-time and asynchronous workflows
Experience with hybrid environments (own data centre + public cloud)
Breadth across both client platforms and backend services

Working At Kobo

We oﬀer competitive compensation, including salary, bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Full details are shared during the hiring process.

Rakuten Kobo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure it's the right experience for you.

The Perks

Flexible hours and hybrid remote working environment
Subsidized in-office lunches
Four extended long weekends in the summer
Full benefits starting from your first day
Paid Volunteer days, unlimited sick days, and 3% RRSP matching
Work From Anywhere Program for up to 3 months (90 days)
Lifestyle spending account
Talent and development training budget
Free Kobo device + free weekly e-book or audiobook
Weekly Kobo Spark sessions
Maternity/paternity leave top up
Dog friendly office

About Rakuten Kobo Inc.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is the world’s digital bookseller created by and for booklovers. Owned by Tokyo-based Rakuten Group, Inc. and headquartered in Toronto, Rakuten Kobo’s millions of worldwide users can read anytime, anywhere, and on any device. With a mission to make reading lives better for all, Rakuten Kobo connects readers to stories using thoughtful and personalized curation of eBooks and audiobooks, and the best dedicated eReaders and apps for reading. With the singular focus of making reading lives the best they can be, Kobo’s open platform allows people to fit reading into more moments in their busy lives. To learn more about Rakuten Kobo, visit www.kobo.com.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accessibility accommodations for candidates with disabilities participating in the selection process are available on request. Any information received related to accommodation needs of applicants will be addressed confidentially.  

Rakuten Kobo would like to thank all applicants for their interest in this role however only qualified candidates will be shortlisted.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Security Transformation Associate Director
jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our clients’ needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people use the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

You Are

Passionate about security, love what you do and have a genuine desire to outsmart the bad guys. You have the experience to analyze a clients’ security posture, anticipate security requirements and help find right-sized solutions based on industry leading practices. You have a proven track record working successfully in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. You’re a creative, analytical problem solver with above average documentation skills who can speak to both technical and non-technical audiences. Can apply deep security skills to design, build and protect enterprise systems, applications, data, assets and people for Accenture and our clients. You are eager to put your skills to use by helping us help our clients inject security at every level of their organization.

Job Description

This is a key role within Accenture’s Cyber practice to sell and lead large security transformation engagements, taking ownership for revenue generation; large, complex delivery; resources and the continued build-out of services and collateral.

This leader will:

Drive business development activities including origination, qualification, capture and relationship development

Maintain relationships with key client stakeholders at the VP and C-suite level

Lead development of written and oral client proposals

Assist in driving overall Security practice growth

Develop, plan and lead large-scale solution delivery efforts across a broad range of industries

Lead, attract and retain multi-discipline, and multi-region teams

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of 15 years of experience designing and delivering large, complex security services to clients.

Experience leading business development and sales capture efforts

Deep network with extensive leadership relationships including at the C-suite level

Experience leading and growing a security consulting practice

Preferred Skills:

Industry-adopted security certifications (e.g. CISSP)

Bachelor or higher degree in a technical field (e.g. Computer Science, CIS, MIS, Engineering)

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location,

role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation, based on full-time

employment, for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

The recruiting efforts for this position are intended to fill a brand new position.

The base pay range shown below is intended as a guideline to reflect the majority of offers for this role.

It does not represent a maximum limit — in some cases, actual compensation may exceed the range where appropriate.

Information on benefits is here.

Role Location Annual Salary Range

British Columbia/Ontario/New Brunswick $161,050 to $319,300
